description: Privacy and personal data protection laws. Applies across sectors wherever personal data is processed.

regulatory_bodies.name: Office of the Privacy Commissioner of Canada
Commission d'accès à l'information du Québec
Office of the Australian Information Commissioner
Swiss Federal Data Protection and Information Commissioner
Autoridade Nacional de Proteção de Dados

regulations.name: Personally Identifiable Information — general handling principles
regulations.issuing_body: Conceptual — incorporated into national data protection regimes
regulations.summary: Baseline principles for PII handling, codified in jurisdiction-specific laws.
key_requirements: Classify — identify what constitutes PII in context
Minimise — collect only what is necessary
Purpose-limit — use only for the purpose collected
Retain only as long as necessary
Secure — encryption at rest and in transit; access control; audit logging
Support access and correction rights for the individual

regulations.name: General Data Protection Regulation
regulations.extra_territorial_scope: Any organisation processing personal data of individuals located in the EU/EEA, regardless of organisation location.
regulations.summary: Comprehensive data protection regulation. Principles: lawfulness, fairness, transparency, purpose limitation, data minimisation, accuracy, storage limitation, integrity and confidentiality, accountability.
key_requirements: Data subject rights (access, rectification, erasure, portability, restriction, objection)

regulations.name: UK GDPR / Data Protection Act 2018
regulations.summary: UK data protection regime post-Brexit. Mirrors EU GDPR substantively with UK-specific derogations.
key_requirements: Core data protection principles as EU GDPR
UK-specific derogations for journalism, research, law enforcement

regulations.name: Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act
regulations.summary: US law for Protected Health Information (PHI). Three rules: Privacy, Security, Breach Notification.
key_requirements: Privacy Rule — uses and disclosures of PHI; individual rights
Security Rule — administrative, physical, technical safeguards for ePHI
Breach Notification Rule — notify individuals, HHS, media for large breaches

regulations.name: Gramm-Leach-Bliley Act
regulations.summary: US law requiring financial institutions to safeguard non-public personal information and explain information-sharing practices.
key_requirements: Safeguards Rule — written information security programme (updated 2023)

regulations.name: California Consumer Privacy Act / California Privacy Rights Act
regulations.extra_territorial_scope: Any for-profit business meeting thresholds that serves California residents.
regulations.summary: California state privacy law. CPRA amendments effective from 2023 expanded rights and created the CPPA.
key_requirements: Consumer rights: access, deletion, correction, opt-out of sale/sharing, limit use of sensitive PI, portability
Contractual requirements on service providers, contractors, third parties
Risk assessments and cybersecurity audits for certain processing

regulations.name: Genetic Information Nondiscrimination Act
regulations.summary: Prohibits discrimination on the basis of genetic information in health insurance (Title I) and employment (Title II).
key_requirements: Health insurers must not use genetic information for coverage or premium decisions
Employers must not use genetic information in employment decisions
Restrictions on requesting, requiring, or purchasing genetic information
Confidentiality of genetic information where lawfully held

regulations.name: Personal Information Protection and Electronic Documents Act
regulations.summary: Federal Canadian private-sector privacy law. Bill C-27 (Consumer Privacy Protection Act) proposed as successor.
key_requirements: Breach of security safeguards notification when real risk of significant harm
Cross-border accountability remains with the Canadian organisation

regulations.name: Quebec Law 25 — Act respecting the protection of personal information in the private sector
regulations.summary: Quebec's modernised private-sector privacy law. Closer to GDPR than PIPEDA.
key_requirements: Breach reporting to CAI and affected individuals for serious risk of harm

regulations.name: Privacy Act 1988
regulations.summary: Australian federal privacy law centred on 13 Australian Privacy Principles. Under substantial reform.
key_requirements: Notifiable Data Breaches scheme to OAIC and individuals

regulations.name: Personal Data Protection Act 2012 (Singapore)
regulations.summary: Singapore's personal data law. 2020 amendment introduced mandatory breach notification and enhanced penalties.
key_requirements: Mandatory breach notification when significant harm or ≥500 individuals
Consent with deemed consent and exceptions

regulations.name: Swiss Federal Act on Data Protection (revised)
regulations.summary: Revised Swiss law substantially GDPR-aligned. Applies to natural persons only (legal persons removed).
key_requirements: Breach notification to FDPIC as soon as possible
International transfer safeguards with adequacy list

regulations.name: UAE Federal Personal Data Protection Law
regulations.summary: UAE federal data protection law. Does not apply to DIFC or ADGM (which have separate regimes).

regulations.name: DIFC Data Protection Law
regulations.summary: GDPR-aligned data protection law for DIFC. Regulation 10 governs AI and autonomous systems processing personal data.

regulations.name: ADGM Data Protection Regulations 2021
regulations.summary: GDPR-aligned data protection regulations for ADGM.

regulations.name: Lei Geral de Proteção de Dados Pessoais
regulations.summary: Brazil's comprehensive data protection law. Substantially GDPR-aligned.
